## Overview

ITCC/ITES 2026 is the premier meeting on thermophysical properties of materials, covering thermal conductivity, diffusivity, thermal expansion, and related phenomena. Emissivity measurement often appears alongside other thermophysical characterization. Co-hosted by Edward Orton Jr. Ceramic Foundation and Hot Disk AB.
